name: speech
description: Transcribe audio to text and speak text as audio.

content.inline:
## Speech
- `transcribe {ref, mediaType?, language?, prompt?}` turns audio at a reference you may read into `{text, language?, seconds?}`; no text means silence. Give `language` when you know it and `prompt` with names likely to be said. A transcript may mishear names, doses and numbers: say what you heard and confirm anything that matters before acting on it.
- `speak {text, voice?, format?}` returns `{ref, mediaType, ...}` for an audio file in your private speech drive; opus (the default) is a voice note. Send it on Telegram with `telegram:call` sendVoice and `{voice: {ref, filename}}`.
- `engines {}` says whether speech runs locally (audio never leaves the venue's machine) and whether a key resolves for you.

An attachment's `text` already holds its transcription when its binding transcribes; do not transcribe it again. Without a transcription, do not claim to have heard audio.
